text:
aisha: Quick follow-up from the vendor outage postmortem. We saw a cloud-region flake cascade into model-registry read spikes and then an auth refresh storm. Need owners, short-term mitigations, and a drill schedule. I'll capture AIs here.

ops-bot: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/vendor-chain-2026-03-22. Runbooks: /runbooks/cloud-failover, /runbooks/registry-fallback, /runbooks/oidc-degrade.

tom: I'll own cloud failover work. Short-term: tighten health checks, reduce fail-open window, run cross-AZ canary. ETA short: 2026-03-30. Long-term: automated app-layer reroute policy. ETA long: 2026-04-20.

rita: I'll take registry resilience. Plan: async manifest replication to regional blob, client-side concurrency caps, and stale-manifest serving mode when registry >30s. ETA: 2026-04-06 for caps+replication, 2026-04-03 for stale mode and tests.

samir: Auth hotfix: add per-process refresh mutex + jittered backoff to avoid parallel refresh storms. I can ship hotfix in 48h (ETA: 2026-03-26). Longer-term: design a token refresh service with signed assertions. ETA: 2026-04-25.

nina: I'll prepare customer impact tags for Dedicated tenants and a short comms template if any AI slips. Please add SLA labels to tickets.

aisha: Draft AI list (please confirm):
- AI-701: Cloud health-check tightening + cross-AZ canary (owner: tom) ETA: 2026-03-30
- AI-702: Registry replication + concurrency caps (owner: rita) ETA: 2026-04-06
- AI-703: Stale-manifest serving + verification harness (owner: rita) ETA: 2026-04-03
- AI-704: Hotfix: per-process refresh mutex + jitter (owner: samir) ETA: 2026-03-26
- AI-705: Runbook drill schedule + test checklist (owner: tom) ETA: 2026-04-02

ops-bot: Tickets created: AI-701, AI-702, AI-703, AI-704, AI-705. Linked to PM-2026-03-22.

samir: Hotfix snippet (in PR) with tests:```python
if not refresh_in_progress:
    refresh_in_progress = True
    try:
        refresh_token()
    finally:
        refresh_in_progress = False
```

tom: Ops will canary the hotfix and the cross-AZ canary tomorrow and post metrics to AI-704 and AI-701. Add rollback criteria: increase in 5xxs or >0.5% user errors.
\krita: (typo) rita: I'll include a checksum diff in the harness to avoid serving mismatched models when using cached manifests.

aisha: Thanks. Two asks before close: 1) add test steps and rollback criteria to each AI ticket, 2) tag dashboards and customers impacted. We'll reconvene at follow-up review on 2026-04-06. If anyone can't meet ETA, update the ticket within 24h.

ops-bot: Follow-up review scheduled 2026-04-06 09:00 PT.

aisha: Closing thread. Keep updates on the AI tickets.
